sections.heading: Profile
paragraphs: FPGA developer working on video-processing pipelines in VHDL on Xilinx devices, with Python-based regression testing. Looking to apply that experience to high-speed FPGA design at Nordlys Semiconductors.

entries.title: FPGA Developer
bullets: Implemented VHDL modules for a video-processing pipeline on Xilinx devices and closed timing at 250 MHz.
Wrote Python test benches with cocotb for regression testing.
